title: Everyday Phrases — Amusement Park Rides
title_quote: How much is a one-day ticket?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎡 實用遊樂園排隊玩設施必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Amusement Park Rides
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用遊樂園排隊玩設施情境對話：買票與快速通行證、排隊與過山車、棉花糖與鬼屋、花車遊行與煙火，一整天的遊樂園對話應有盡有（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Amusement Park Rides phrase pairs — tickets and fast passes, long lines and roller coasters, cotton candy, haunted houses, parades and fireworks (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a one-day ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə wʌn deɪ ˈtɪkɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty dollars for one adult.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a discount for children?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids under ten get half off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are four people in total.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your total is two hundred forty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay with a card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cash or card is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do online tickets cost less?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, five dollars off each one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy them online now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就在線上買好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the line moves faster.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，隊伍會走得快些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a season pass worth it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you come back often.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We plan three trips this summer.
dialogue.zh: 我們這個夏天打算來三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the season pass saves money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pass include all rides?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every ride is included.
dialogue.zh: 是的，每項設施都含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need a photo for the pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju nid ə ˈfoʊtoʊ fər ðə pæs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will face the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fast pass really worth buying?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fæst pæs ˈrɪli wɜrθ ˈbaɪɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 快速通行證真的值得買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On busy days it saves hours.
dialogue.zh: 在人多的日子能省好幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does the fast pass cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðə fæst pæs kɔst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty extra dollars per person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the fast pass let us do?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə fæst pæs lɛt ʌs du?/
dialogue.zh: 快速通行證能讓我們做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You skip most of the long lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju skɪp moʊst ʌv ðə lɔŋ laɪnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pick our favorite rides?
dialogue.zh: 可以自己挑想玩的設施嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, choose three rides on it.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在上面選三項設施。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it work for the big coaster?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt wɜrk fər ðə bɪɡ ˈkoʊstər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the coaster is covered too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us get four fast passes then.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡɛt fɔr fæst ˈpæsɪz ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就買四張快速通行證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, we will ride much more.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣能玩更多項目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we park the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lot C has room, the near ones are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑt si hæz rum, ðə nɪr wʌnz ɑr fʊl./
dialogue.zh: C 停車場還有空位，近的幾處都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is parking free with a pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, parking is fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car is really far away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a free shuttle bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the bus reach us?
dialogue.zh: 擺渡車多久會到我們這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About five minutes at most.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shuttle stop at every lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈʃʌtl stɑp æt ˈɛvri lɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 擺渡車每個停車場都停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it runs in one loop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope we find the car tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp wi faɪnd ðə kɑr təˈnaɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a photo of your spot now.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv jʊr spɑt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在先拍一張車位照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the line to get in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪs ðɪs ðə laɪn tu ɡɛt ɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the gate is over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please scan your ticket at the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz skæn jʊr ˈtɪkɪt æt ðə ˈridər./
dialogue.zh: 請在讀卡器上掃碼門票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It beeped, so we are good.
dialogue.zh: 嗶了一聲，我們可以進了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wristband is my ticket now.
dialogue.zh: 這個手環就是我的門票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not take it off all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt teɪk ɪt ɔf ɔl deɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my band falls off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask staff and show your ID.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave and come back in?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv ænd kʌm bæk ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以出去再回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, get a stamp on your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɡɛt ə stæmp ɑn jʊr hænd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are strollers allowed inside the park?
dialogue.zh: 園區裡可以推嬰兒車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, or rent one near the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɔr rɛnt wʌn nɪr ðə ɡeɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a stroller for a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə ˈstroʊlər fər ə deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs ten dollars a day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boy is under four feet tall.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔɪ ɪz ˈʌndər fɔr fit tɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He may be too short still.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do they measure kids' height?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the sign by each entrance.
dialogue.zh: 在每個入口的標示牌旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He grew an inch since last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɡru ən ɪntʃ sɪns læst jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 他比去年長高了一英寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us check the mark today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he pass the height test?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just barely, he is so happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does our daughter need one too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every rider needs one.
dialogue.zh: 要，每個要玩的人都要一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have lockers for backpacks?
dialogue.zh: 你們有放背包的寄物櫃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, along the hall to your right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, əˈlɔŋ ðə hɔl tu jʊr raɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a large locker?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six dollars for the whole day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need coins to use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid kɔɪnz tu juz ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just tap your card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open it more than once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈoʊpən ɪt mɔr ðæn wʌns?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, come back anytime today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we leave our jackets here?
dialogue.zh: 我們外套就放這裡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it will get hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my water bottle safe inside?
dialogue.zh: 我的水壺放裡面安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it locks very tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the guest services desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the lost and found office.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a free paper map?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə fri ˈpeɪpər mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 能給我一張免費紙地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one next to the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a group rate for schools?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ɡrup reɪt fər skulz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten or more gets it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are students given any discount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your card for five off.
dialogue.zh: 出示學生證可折五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time can we enter today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gates open at nine sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do the gates close tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At ten, after the fireworks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which window is for the passes?
dialogue.zh: 哪個窗口是領通行證的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the window on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have the code on your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə koʊd ɑn jʊr foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你有把序號存在手機裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will show the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids need their own band too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du kɪdz nid ðɛr oʊn bænd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 小孩也要戴自己的手環嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone gets one at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 每個人在門口都領一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are finally inside the park!
dialogue.zh: 我們終於進到園區裡了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First stop, the biggest coaster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line looks really long.
dialogue.zh: 這條隊伍看起來真的很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We may wait almost an hour.
dialogue.zh: 我們可能要排將近一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sign says forty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫還要四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, that is fine with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way does the line move?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the path past the fence.
dialogue.zh: 沿著圍欄外的小路跟著走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to join here?
dialogue.zh: 從這裡加入隊伍可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, go back to the tail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fast pass line is shorter.
dialogue.zh: 快速通行證的隊伍短一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky we bought the passes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we show the pass to staff?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ʃoʊ ðə pæs tu stæf?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要把通行證給工作人員看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, scan it at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you come here a lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every summer since I was small.
dialogue.zh: 我從小到大，每個夏天都來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you ridden this before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it is so thrilling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the best ride here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡最好玩的設施是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drop tower, hands down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is so strong today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put on sunscreen for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this sunscreen work well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it smells like coconuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow the sunscreen, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, rub your nose too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders are already burning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, drink some cold water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my bottle still full?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost empty, buy one soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water bottles are expensive here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars for one bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refill it at the free station.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, cold water for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the coaster is right ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear the screams already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am too scared to ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is safer than it looks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people ever throw up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, just breathe and relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I will skip this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come on, you can do it!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I scream, do not laugh.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, I already laughed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How tall is this ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten stories up high.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it go upside down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice near the end, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are sweating now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them on your shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The train is pulling in!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, line up by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have the back seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back row is wildest, you sure?
dialogue.zh: 最後一排最刺激，你確定？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the shoulder bar go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it down until it clicks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bar hurts my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise your arms, it fits better.
dialogue.zh: 把手舉起來，就會好一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seatbelt locked now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the green light means safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check your pockets for loose things.
dialogue.zh: 檢查口袋有沒有易掉的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I emptied both pockets already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經把兩個口袋都清空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take off your hat and shoes.
dialogue.zh: 請把帽子和鞋子脫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sandals will fly off!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No hats, no phones on this ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hæts, noʊ ˈfoʊnz ɑn ðɪs raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 這個設施不能帶帽子和手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a bin right by the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɪn raɪt baɪ ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 座位旁邊就有一個置物箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my glasses fall off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A strap keeps them on tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drop comes first, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, count to three with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we go, hold on tight!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cannot believe we are doing this.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt bɪˈliv wi ɑr ˈduɪŋ ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信我們真的在玩這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it, we are alive!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was amazing, let us go again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz əˈmeɪzɪŋ, lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 太精彩了，我們再玩一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel like rubber now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You screamed the loudest there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that big loop?
dialogue.zh: 你看到那個大回環了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I had my eyes closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What ride should we try next?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The log flume has a short line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɑɡ fluːm hæz ə ʃɔrt laɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the one with water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you will get soaked there.
dialogue.zh: 對，坐那個一定會全身濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do ponchos cost a lot here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine dollars at the shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us buy two before riding.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, keep our phones dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crew is waving us forward.
dialogue.zh: 工作人員在揮手讓我們上前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step up when they point at you.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ʌp wɛn ðeɪ pɔɪnt æt ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not stand until the bar lifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt stænd ʌnˈtɪl ðə bɑr lɪfts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait for the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ wil weɪt fər ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，我等指示燈亮了再動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we exit the ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the steps on your left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is a total mess.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who cares, that was fun!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a ride photo of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə raɪd ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我想買一張我們的玩照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the kiosk near the exit.
dialogue.zh: 出口附近的自助機就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those kids in front look brave.
dialogue.zh: 前面那幾個小孩好勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They rode it three times already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a break from standing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us sit by the fountain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready for the coaster once more?
dialogue.zh: 準備好再坐一次過山車了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am ready, you first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel the ground is spinning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and close your eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That ride made me so dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water helps, drink a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a restroom right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is past the old carousel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel like throwing up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I feel fine now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stomach is still up there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe deep, it will settle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell that sugar in the air!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cotton candy cart is calling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have one pink, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want the big size?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One big pink cloud, please.
dialogue.zh: 請來一朵大大的粉色雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will be five dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It melts in my hands already.
dialogue.zh: 它已經在我手上融化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lick it fast, do not drop it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪk ɪt fæst, du nɑt drɑp ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also want some popcorn.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter or caramel flavor?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Butter please, the biggest bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, still warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This popcorn is warm and salty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a handful from me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not spill it on my shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt spɪl ɪt ɑn maɪ ʃuz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dark house looks scary.
dialogue.zh: 那座黑黑的房子好可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you dare to go in?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am not going in first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will lead then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door just opened by itself!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is just a trick, relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something just touched my arm!
dialogue.zh: 有什麼東西碰到我手臂！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was just a fake spider.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that flying skeleton?
dialogue.zh: 你看到那具會飛的骷髏了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw nothing, eyes shut tight.
dialogue.zh: 我什麼都沒看，眼睛閉緊緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer in this house?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more minutes, then we leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs feel kind of shaky.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the best scare ever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it too scary for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but I will go again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, bʌt aɪ wil ɡoʊ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但我想再玩一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spinning cups look so cute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They spin faster than they look.
dialogue.zh: 轉起來比看起來快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we spin the wheel ourselves?
dialogue.zh: 轉盤是我們自己轉的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, turn it as hard as you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɜrn ɪt əs hɑrd əs ju wɑnt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round and round, I love this!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I am the dizzy one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who feels sick now, hmm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not me, I feel totally fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more ride on the log flume!
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr raɪd ɑn ðə lɑɡ fluːm!/
dialogue.zh: 激流勇進我們再玩一次！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the top it pauses a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə tɑp ɪt ˈpɔzəz ə ˈsɛkənd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get ready, the drop is coming!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get ready to get wet!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are soaked from the waist down!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr soʊkt frʌm ðə weɪst daʊn!/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shorts are heavy with water.
dialogue.zh: 我的短褲吸滿了水，好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you save your phone at least?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju seɪv jʊr foʊn æt list?/
dialogue.zh: 至少你的手機保住了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stayed dry inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ponchos were such a good idea.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at others without them!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I slipped a little on the deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɪpt ə ˈlɪtəl ɑn ðə dɛk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch your step, it is slippery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I buy dry clothes?
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡能買到乾衣服？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store sells cheap T-shirts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pink one fits me best.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two, I need one too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at those dark clouds coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain is coming for sure now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do rides stop in a thunderstorm?
dialogue.zh: 打雷下雨時設施會停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they close for safety.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quick, run to that big tent!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already full of people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is room under the roof.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can wait it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone is dancing in the rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe I will join them later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How heavy this rain is!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Summer showers pass quickly.
dialogue.zh: 夏天的陣雨過去得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have dry socks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one spare pair in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn spɛr pɛr ɪn ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，包裡還有一雙備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes squish with every step.
dialogue.zh: 我每走一步鞋子都咕嘰響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change now, feel better soon.
dialogue.zh: 快換一下，馬上就會舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is back at last!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line is growing again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything smells fresh after rain.
dialogue.zh: 雨後什麼都聞起來很清新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the lights look prettier now.
dialogue.phonetic: / ænd ðə laɪts lʊk ˈprɪtiər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 而且彩燈現在更好看了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us ride the carousel tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們去坐旋轉木馬吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It glows like a little star.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy one more treat?
dialogue.zh: 我們能再買一份點心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you share with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot finish this giant lemonade.
dialogue.zh: 這大杯檸檬水我喝不完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will help, half for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the band is playing live!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us listen for a few songs.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈlɪsən fər ə fju sɔŋz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us ride the teacups one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs raɪd ðə ˈtiˌkʌps wʌn mɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我們再去玩一次旋轉茶杯吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if I pick the red cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf aɪ pɪk ðə rɛd kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 好，但我要選紅色那個杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet hurt from all this walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit hɜrt frʌm ɔl ðɪs ˈwɔkɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more rides, then we rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the kids want the Ferris wheel?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə kɪdz wɑnt ðə ˈfɛrɪs wil?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the view up there is lovely.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə vju ʌp ðɛr ɪz ˈlʌvli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the parade start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It begins at seven tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is a good spot to watch?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ə ɡʊd spɑt tu wɑtʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the flag near the castle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People are already saving places.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit here, we got the corner.
dialogue.zh: 坐這裡，我們佔到轉角了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the parade worth the wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, every float glows.
dialogue.zh: 當然值得，每輛花車都發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the characters wave at us?
dialogue.zh: 卡通角色會向我們揮手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the ducks always wave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the first music float!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dancers are so bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take a video of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ə ˈvɪdioʊ ʌv ðɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will hold your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That princess dress shines gold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My daughter wants one exactly.
dialogue.zh: 我女兒正想要一件一模一樣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The parade songs stay in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pəˈreɪd sɔŋz steɪ ɪn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 遊行的歌一直在我腦中回響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am humming one right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在就在哼其中一首。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do the fireworks begin?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, right after the night show.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side gives the best view?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bridge side, if you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we eat while we watch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but no glass bottles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved a glow stick for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ə ɡloʊ stɪk fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 我幫你留了一支發光棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are the best today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, here comes the first boom!
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn, tu, hɪr kʌmz ðə fɜrst bum!/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gold flowers over the whole castle!
dialogue.zh: 金色的花灑滿整個城堡！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky is purple now!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And that one just like stars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the last round already?
dialogue.zh: 這已經是最後一輪了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the big finale comes next.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those big booms hurt my ears.
dialogue.zh: 那幾聲巨響弄得我耳朵好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand back from the fence.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The river of lights is glowing.
dialogue.zh: 河面上倒映著一片燈光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reflects the fireworks too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make a wish on the biggest one.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ə wɪʃ ɑn ðə ˈbɪɡɪst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wish we could stay longer.
dialogue.zh: 我希望我們能多待一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my baseball hat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you leave it on the bench?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju liv ɪt ɑn ðə bɛntʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 你是不是落在長椅上了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had it at the popcorn stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ həd ɪt æt ðə ˈpɑpkɔrn stænd./
dialogue.zh: 在爆米花攤時我還拿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the tables near there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A worker found a blue hat.
dialogue.zh: 一位員工找到一頂藍帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the one you lost?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is my lost hat!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staff here are really kind.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的工作人員真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hold on to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or clip it on your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The exit gift shop is huge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So many plush animals!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a mug from this park.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə mʌɡ frʌm ðɪs pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 我想要這個園區的馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the coaster picture one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much are these keychains?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two for five dollars today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buy a shirt for grandma too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, she loves souvenirs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these mouse ears soft enough?
dialogue.zh: 這對米老鼠耳朵夠軟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze them, soft like a cloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They fit me perfectly, look!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take them home with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One mug, one shirt, two keychains.
dialogue.zh: 一個杯子、一件上衣、兩個鑰匙圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the mouse ears, fifty dollars total.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə maʊs ɪrz, ˈfɪfti ˈdɑlərz ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 加上那對米老鼠耳朵，總共五十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line to pay is moving slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn tu peɪ ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ sloʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Self-checkout is open, look.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my phone to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz maɪ foʊn tu peɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it near the small reader.
dialogue.zh: 把它靠近那個小讀卡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we get bags for these?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the cups break easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt in the email, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check it before we leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The parking lot is packed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every car wants to leave now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shuttle will take ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or we walk and stretch legs.
dialogue.zh: 或者我們走著活動腿腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Traffic barely moves on this road.
dialogue.zh: 這條路上的車流幾乎不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows another way home.
dialogue.zh: 導航顯示另一條回家的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fell asleep in the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You slept the whole way back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boy is already snoring.
dialogue.zh: 我兒子已經開始打呼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry him in, do not wake him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæri hɪm ɪn, du nɑt weɪk hɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a perfect day at the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə ˈpɜrfɪkt deɪ æt ðə pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 在遊樂園度過完美的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smiled from start to end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the roller coaster scare you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way, I loved every part.
dialogue.zh: 才沒有，我從頭玩到尾都愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boy wants to come back soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr bɔɪ wɑnts tə kʌm bæk sun./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will plan it, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 我們會安排好的，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will dream about fireworks tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dream of the spinning teacups too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we can sleep in late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush tonight, we are worn out.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ təˈnaɪt, wi ɑr wɔrn aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚不用趕，我們倆都累壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the photo from the drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ frʌm ðə drɑp./
dialogue.zh: 這是俯衝那一刻拍的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I look so silly in this one!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʊk soʊ ˈsɪli ɪn ðɪs wʌn!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape it up beside the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪt ʌp bɪˈsaɪd ðə frʌnt dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, beside the park map.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, little roller coaster fan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night, I had so much fun.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我今天玩得好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will a weekday line be shorter?
dialogue.zh: 平日的隊伍會比較短嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekdays are much calmer here.
dialogue.zh: 平日這裡人少清淨多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Tuesday, we start at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, sleep well, dream big.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，好好睡，做個大夢。
